description: This file implements the QwenLLMService class which extends OpenAILLMService to provide a wrapper for interacting with Alibaba Cloud's Qwen LLM API using an OpenAI-compatible interface. It includes class initialization and client creation methods, with logging for service setup.

classes.name: QwenLLMService
classes.description: A service for interacting with Alibaba Cloud's Qwen LLM API using the OpenAI-compatible interface. Extends OpenAILLMService to connect to Qwen's API endpoint while maintaining full compatibility with OpenAI's interface and functionality.

methods.description: Creates an OpenAI-compatible client configured for Qwen's API endpoint. Allows overriding default api_key and base_url, and passes additional arguments to the parent method.
